items.question: What services does Digiforma Tech Solution provide?
items.answer: Digiforma Tech Solution provides IT consulting and software house services, including IT Master Plan (ITMP) development, Enterprise Architecture, COBIT 2019 IT governance framework implementation, as well as custom application development to support your business digital transformation.

items.question: What is IT Master Plan (ITMP) and why is it important for business?
items.answer: IT Master Plan (ITMP) is a long-term strategic plan that integrates IT strategy with business objectives. ITMP helps organizations design a measurable digitalization roadmap, optimize IT investments, and ensure technology supports sustainable business growth.

items.question: What is Enterprise Architecture and what are its benefits?
items.answer: Enterprise Architecture is a framework for designing organizational structure, business processes, information systems, and technology in an integrated manner. Benefits include improving operational efficiency, reducing system duplication, facilitating scalability, and ensuring alignment between IT and business strategy.

items.question: What is COBIT 2019 and how is it implemented?
items.answer: COBIT 2019 is a comprehensive IT governance framework for managing and governing information technology. Implementation includes IT governance maturity assessment, target state design, gap analysis, and implementation roadmap to achieve effective IT governance aligned with international best practices.

items.question: How long does an IT consulting project take?
items.answer: IT consulting project duration varies depending on complexity and scope. IT Master Plan typically takes 2-4 months, Enterprise Architecture 3-6 months, and COBIT 2019 implementation can take 6-12 months depending on organizational maturity level. We provide a clear timeline at the beginning of the project.

items.question: Does Digiforma also provide software development services?
items.answer: Yes, as a software house, we also develop custom applications according to business needs. We develop various types of applications including ERP System, Cooperative System, Point of Sale (POS), Decision Support System, and other business applications using modern technology and best practices.
